args.summary: Fixed the bug in `separability_matrix` for nested CompoundModels. The issue was in the `_cstack` function in `/testbed/astropy/modeling/separable.py`. When the right operand was already a separability matrix (i.e., a nested CompoundModel), the code incorrectly set the entire bottom-right block to 1s instead of copying the actual separability matrix. Changed line 247 from `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = 1` to `cright[-right.shape[0]:, -right.shape[1]:] = right`.
